# DonorDock Pricing

DonorDock offers straightforward pricing for nonprofit donor management:

## Pricing Tiers

**Starting at $99/month** (billed annually)

The pricing is based on the number of donor records in your database:

- **Up to 1,000 contacts**: $99/month
- **Up to 2,500 contacts**: $149/month
- **Up to 5,000 contacts**: $249/month
- **Up to 10,000 contacts**: $399/month
- **10,000+ contacts**: Custom pricing

## What's Included

All plans include:
- Unlimited users
- Donor management & CRM
- Online donation forms
- Email campaigns
- Automated receipting
- Reporting and analytics
- Integrations
- Customer support

## Key Features

- **Free trial available** (14 days, no credit card required)
- **Annual billing** (monthly billing may be available at higher rates)
- **All-in-one platform** - no additional fees for features like email or forms
- Designed specifically for small to mid-sized nonprofits

## Notes

Pricing may have changed since my last update. I recommend visiting **donordock.com/pricing** or contacting their sales team directly for the most current pricing and to discuss your specific needs.
